versions.changelog:
- Bumped version metadata to 0.1.2.
- Removed the version field from SKILL.md frontmatter for improved consistency.
- No user-facing logic or workflow changes in this release.
Add homepage link to GitHub source repository (https://github.com/SoulZhong/recruiting-skills).

Initial release of recruiting-resume-screening skill.

- Provides structured workflow for evaluating Chinese-language resumes against job descriptions.
- Emphasizes evidence-based, multi-dimensional assessment rather than keyword matching.
- Includes PDF extraction guidelines using multiple backends for robust text retrieval.
- Outlines step-by-step process: extraction, triage, five-dimension evaluation, red flag identification, and output discipline.
- Enforces reporting standards and anti-patterns to ensure consistency and prevent bias.
- Supplies self-checklists and feedback mechanisms for continuous improvement.
